cue_correspondence.text: Workforce gives administrators a place to connect an employer, operating
locations, people, and dated work records.
Start on the Workforce Overview.
The empty example has no employer profile, workers, or employments.
We will build one small training record, then save two unapproved hours.
Use an account authorized for these pages and a fictional practice department.
These entries describe a software exercise, not
verified attendance or payroll.
Open Employer and find Employer profile.
In Legal name, enter a clearly marked training name; this example
uses Community coordination services with a TRAINING ONLY prefix.
Tax identifiers, addresses, and
filing contacts stay empty in this clean practice profile.
Read the blue protection notice before editing an existing employer.
required_labels: Coverage is declared by you, never determined by Resgrid.

cue_correspondence.text: Review stored information carefully rather than replacing a real
organization’s details with the values from this demonstration.
Scroll to Coverage status.
Keep Not declared for this fictional example, leave the employee
headcounts empty, and leave Part of an integrated enterprise unchecked.
This exercise makes no decision about filing coverage.
Choose Save at the bottom of the employer form.
The Saved message confirms the response,
and the fresh employer view retains the training name.
Check that name before moving on to the location records.
Open Establishments and choose Add establishment.
An establishment gives later records a named operating location.
Enter a recognizable Code and Name.
Here the code is TRN-COMM-28, and State is IL.
Major activity describes fictional coordination exercises.
The address and industry-code fields remain blank in this example.
A short, distinctive code helps you recognize the same location when a worker
or time-entry form offers it later.
Continue down the establishment form.
Set Active from to October twenty-eighth, twenty twenty-six,
leave Active to empty, and enter America slash Chicago in Time zone.
Headquarters and Reported in the prior year remain unchecked.
Choose this form’s Save.
The catalog now shows the training base, IL, and Active Yes.
In the reopened establishment, check the date and time zone again so the saved
location matches the setup you intended.
Open Workers.
The Add worker panel offers a Member picker and separate External
worker key and Display label fields.
For this example, select the existing fictional member Matthew
Casey, leave the external fields blank, and choose Add worker.
Casey’s Worker page opens with Active checked and no employment periods yet.
This creates a Workforce link for an existing member; it does
not invite a new user or assign anyone to an operational crew.
From Casey’s page, choose Add employment.
Worker kind is Volunteer in this practice record.
Set Start and End to the same October twenty-eighth date to keep
the example limited to one day.
Employment type and Exemption remain Unknown.
The dates belong to this worker’s employment period, rather than
the establishment’s active window.
Before saving, check the person and both dates so you do not attach
the exercise to the wrong period.
Select the training base in Default establishment and the existing
Community response navigator training role in Personnel role.
The role field helps choose compensation defaults; it does not
change Casey’s response staffing.
Leave Labor contractor and Affiliate blank.
Scroll to the Save inside the employment panel, below those choices; the
Worker panel has a separate Save.
After saving, the one-day Volunteer period
appears, and its reopened form retains the selected defaults.
Within that period, choose Add assignment.
Check the new form: it carries the establishment forward, but Work
location initially shows US and CA.
Change the state to IL for this exercise.
Give Effective and Expires the same one-day bounds, enter the TRAINING
ONLY Coordination exercise job title, and keep Work mode Non-remote.
Review the location explicitly; inheriting an establishment does not mean every
other location field was copied with it.
The assignment also has CRD job category, SOC, and Cal OES
MARS classification fields.
We leave those classifications and Mapping provenance empty in this
fictional exercise; a training title supplies no classification authority.
Choose Save in the assignment form.
Its row now shows the dated coordination exercise, the training
establishment, and Non-remote.
In the reopened assignment, verify IL and the matching dates before
continuing to the daily work entry.
Open Work entries.
The two date controls define the list’s viewing window; the displayed
window includes October twenty-eighth.
No entries are listed yet.
required_labels: No work entries in this window.

cue_correspondence.text: Check the window before assuming a saved record is missing.
Choose Add work entry to open the entry panel beside the list.
This page records a worker and date, hours, location, and supporting context,
so keep the training worker and the intended day together as you fill it.
Check Worker is Matthew Casey and Date is October twenty-eighth.
Enter two in Hours and keep Hours type Regular.
Select the training establishment and keep Work mode Non-remote.
Under Country and State slash province, use US and IL.
These location fields also need their own review.
The two hours are a fictional software example, so choose values appropriate
to your authorized practice record rather than treating the demonstration
as evidence someone actually worked.
Continue to the lower form.
Leave Call number and Deployment id empty because this exercise is not
linked to an incident or deployment.
Approved payroll cost stays blank, and Approved stays unchecked.
Use External source and a distinct External id to identify your
authorized training entry; do not reuse another record’s reference.
These narrow inputs may clip long text.
Review the form, then choose Save to store the unapproved entry.
The saved list now shows Casey, two Regular hours, the training establishment,
and Academy software exercise in Context.
Approved reads No.
The fresh Edit work entry view retains the worker, date,
hours, and Illinois location.
Lower down, Approved is still unchecked and the payroll-cost box is empty.
This is the useful stopping point: a stored, reviewable training record.
Saving has not approved payroll, paid anyone, or verified attendance.
Return to Overview.
One establishment, one worker, and one employment are now recorded;

cue_correspondence.text: Use the same prepare, save, and read-back pattern for fire and EMS
training administration, community-care or mental-health coordination,
search-and-rescue volunteers, security teams, wildland contractors,
and industrial response teams.
Keep each organization’s real classifications and approvals
with its authorized reviewers.
The common skill is connecting the right person, dates, place, and
unapproved record before further review.
